experiment: BM25 corpus-size and warm sequential query benchmark

parameters.corpus_subset: first N documents in corpus file

notes: Timing excludes corpus load and index build; includes only in-process BM25 lookup. Peak RSS covers the entire Python process (including the corpus subset), not index-only allocation. This is not concurrent throughput, and is not an IR relevance evaluation. The query workload uses TREC-COVID query texts without qrels. Subsets are not representative random samples; never compare quality across sizes.
